title: RES↔DATA-001: FAIR Dataset Archival + Research-to-Training Pipeline
description: Researcher delivers FAIR-compliant experimental datasets (+ datasheet, schema docs, research-to-training flag); Data archives with DVC versioning and lineage, returns a Data Ingestion Report, and makes flagged datasets available to ML within 10 business days. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.10 and IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.6.

delivery_point.description: One of the three contracted delivery points.

findable_id.description: Assigned DOI or persistent identifier where applicable.

metadata_included.description: Instrument calibration, environmental conditions, collection protocol.

datasheet.description: Per-dataset datasheet following the organizational standard.

schema_documentation_path.description: Data schema documentation for all experimental data structures.

research_to_training_flag.description: True identifies the dataset as an ML training candidate (triggers the research-to-training pipeline).

data_ingestion_report.description: DATA→RES: validation outcome within 15 business days of receipt.

dvc_version.description: DVC snapshot version assigned on successful ingest.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine dataset archival/ingestion (agent-autonomous). PII-bearing research data escalates to SEC (ESC-SEC); training-candidate promotion feeds ML↔DATA-001.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (delivery at experiment completion / manuscript submission / Technology Transfer); SLA_FROM_EVENT (DATA acks within 2 business days, validates within 10, Ingestion Report within 15; flagged training data available within 10 business days)
confirm_conditions: FAIR attributes complete (raw + processed + labels + metadata) and datasheet present with intended_use, methodology, limitations
data_ingestion_report.validation_result = PASS with a dvc_version assigned
reject_conditions: missing datasheet or incomplete FAIR metadata
validation_result = FAIL with unresolved data gaps
PII present without a SEC privacy-impact escalation
counter_conditions: metadata insufficient for reproducibility — request additional collection-protocol detail
domain-specific features unclear for training promotion — request scientific context (RES responds within 5 business days)
